verdict.rationale: Supermemory exposes API/SDK operations for add, search, update, and delete of memories/documents (client.add, client.search, document-operations list/get/update/delete), plus an official MCP server so agents can invoke these as tools mid-conversation, with container tags scoping per-user memory. This directly supports an agent autonomously managing its own memory via tool/API calls. Missing for 10: no hands-on/independent evidence of an agent actually performing multi-step add/search/update/delete in a live conversation, and no explicit delete-memory (vs delete-document) API example.
